gateways.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Station
gateways.notes: Joetsu Shinkansen station and the main gateway to Naeba, Kagura, GALA Yuzawa and 16 other Yuzawa ski areas. Naeba Prince free shuttle departs from the West Exit.

gateways.name: Tokyo Station
gateways.notes: Joetsu Shinkansen origin. ~75 minutes to Echigo-Yuzawa makes Naeba the closest major powder area to Tokyo.

gateways.name: Tokyo Haneda Airport
gateways.notes: Most domestic and regional international flights. ~30 min by Keikyu + JR to Tokyo Station.

gateways.name: Narita International Airport
gateways.notes: Most long-haul carriers. Allow 1 h Narita Express → Tokyo Station, then 75 min Joetsu Shinkansen to Echigo-Yuzawa.

routes.notes: Joetsu Shinkansen. Tanigawa terminates at Echigo-Yuzawa or GALA; Toki continues to Niigata.
Free shuttle from Echigo-Yuzawa Station West Exit to the Naeba Prince base. Open to non-guests too; show your Mt. Naeba pass or hotel booking.
Local loop around Yuzawa town, useful for reaching the public onsen and town ryokan from the station.
Occasional direct seasonal coach service; otherwise the shinkansen + Prince shuttle route is the standard path.

in_resort_transport.name: Mt. Naeba Inter-Resort Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Free shuttle linking Naeba and Kagura bases for skiers using the Mt. Naeba lift pass (complements the Dragondola).

in_resort_transport.name: Naeba Prince Internal Shuttle
in_resort_transport.notes: Internal cart shuttle moving guests between the Naeba Prince's four wings and the lift base.
